$comment: sherpa-layout-panels — GENERATED by scripts/generate-component-spec.mjs from its .html, .css and .ts. Regenerate it, never edit it. $extensions.sherpa is kept across regen; resync-figma.mjs owns it.
$description: a panel AREA each side of the content. A docked panel fills its area flush, top, side and bottom; the area takes its width and draws the divider, and the content reflows beside it. The area's inner edge resizes it. Two panels stack top and bottom. The area OWNS their mode: a panel asks (`panel-mode-change`), the area writes it on both, and a panel that floats leaves for the float layer, whose room is the whole layout. The app shell's body and the canvas compose it. Will, TODO 796. TRAP T-a-panel-area-is-a-layout

props.name: data-no-room
props.description: both areas hide: the host's rule leaves the content no room for one  Dragging a FLOATING panel by its header within `--sherpa-panel-dock-threshold` (4rem) of the layout's left or right edge lights up where it would dock: an empty side, a card at the edge; a side with one panel, the new half of the split, by the pointer's height. A drop on it docks the panel, in the area's mode; a side with two panels offers nothing. Escape cancels. TRAP T-a-dragged-panel-docks-where-the-area-lights-up

props.name: data-panel-end-width
props.description: an area's width, in px: what a reader dragged it to, handed back by the host. Never under the area's min nor over its max

props.name: data-panel-start-width
props.description: an area's width, in px: what a reader dragged it to, handed back by the host. Never under the area's min nor over its max

slots.name: panel-start
slots.description: the panels docked before the content (two at most, stacked top and bottom; a third is not shown): shut, gone or with no room they take none; an overlay or a tab, the area gives its room back.
the content, between the areas; one cell, so what is slotted stacks in it

slots.name: panel-end
slots.description: the panels docked after the content, the same

slots.name: panel-float
slots.description: the floating panels: off their area, they float in the layout

populate.description: Its declared props by name: `label` sets data-label.

capabilities.description: callable from a view definition's state block (areaMin, docked, modeOf, dock). See $extensions.sherpa.methods.

events.name: panel-area-resize
events.description: An area's inner edge was dragged, or moved by the keys.

events.name: panel-dock
events.description: A dragged panel was dropped on a lit area and docked there.

methods.name: areaMin
methods.description: The narrowest an area may be drawn, in px: its least, never over its own max.

methods.name: docked
methods.description: The panels docked in an area now: its slot's, open, not hidden as a third.

methods.name: modeOf
methods.description: The area's current mode: what its panels share. None, fixed.

methods.name: dock
methods.description: Dock a floating panel into an area, as the second panel where one is there. `place` says above or below the one there. False where the area is full. It joins the area as it is: a stack, fixed; a group, open, the others its tabs.
